extension.description: Proto3 syntax highlighting, go-to-definition, and TypeScript code generation
command.generateAllTypes: Proto Utils: Generate TypeScript Types (All Protos)
config.runner.server: gRPC server address (host:port) for RPC Runner calls
config.runner.protoDir: Directory containing the .proto files themselves — imports resolve against it, so pointing at a parent directory breaks cross-file type resolution. Empty = workspace root; relative paths resolve against the workspace folder. When set, code generation also scans only this directory instead of the workspace. Requires a window reload to take effect.
config.codeGen.outputDir: Output directory for generated TypeScript files (relative to workspace root)
config.codeGen.enumStyle: Generate enums as TypeScript enum or union type
config.codeGen.optionalMessageFields: Mark non-repeated message-typed fields as optional (?)
config.codeGen.fieldNaming: Field naming convention in generated TypeScript
config.codeGen.pathMapping: Output path mapping: 'file' = mirror folder structure relative to the protos' common root; 'package' = directories by proto package declaration
config.codeGen.importExtension: Append '.ts' to generated import paths (needs allowImportingTsExtensions or a bundler to resolve)
config.scan.excludeDirs: Extra folders to skip when scanning protos (runner + code generation). Entry forms: plain folder name (matches any path segment, e.g. 'out-vscode'), workspace-relative path, or absolute path. Requires a window reload to take effect.
config.codeGen.oneofStyle: Generate oneof as simple optional fields or discriminated union
